ios.desc:
Sigma is a universal browser for your favorite websites and social networks, allowing you to vote and comment on interesting topics of any kind and discuss with the community.

Features:

- Search through all websites at once to easily find anything that comes to your mind

- Integrated Adblock to make your browsing more comfortable

- Ranking system that allows you to vote, comment and reply to other users

- Bookmark webpages and add them to your own collections for an easy access later

- Beautiful media viewer for effortless image board browsing

- Hand-crafted video player with simple yet powerful gestures for seeking, Picture in Picture, AirPlay, 0.5x-2x playback speed and even media download for offline access

- Support for various media formats such as WebM and MKV

- Various themes and app icons for a fresh and unique look

Download Sigma and join the community today!
